clue.text: Plant appearing different in lead

indicators.note: in tells us one piece sits inside the chemical symbol for the metal

parts.note: Pb is the chemical symbol for lead
different means other

explanation.surface: A plant that looks unusual when grown in lead.
explanation.definitionFit: A pot-herb is a leafy plant grown for the cooking pot.

clue.text: Fish with bird on top

definitions.meaning: a roost where a bird sits, something a bird is on top of

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a freshwater fish and the bar a bird sits on.

clue.text: Cruise virus needs no intro played with drum roll?

parts.note: Tom Cruise, the film star

indicators.note: needs no intro means the first letter is removed

parts.note: Ebola is a virus

explanation.surface: Tom Cruise catches a virus that needs no introduction, to a drum roll.
explanation.definitionFit: A tombola is a lottery game whose tickets are drawn from a revolving drum.

clue.text: Bird needs heart with wings clipped

indicators.note: with wings clipped means the outer letters are cut from each side

parts.note: the kernel is the heart or core of something

explanation.surface: A bird must have courage despite having its wings clipped.
explanation.definitionFit: An erne is a sea eagle, a crossword favourite.

clue.text: Duty owed here to James, incomplete prince, English Stuart perhaps

parts.note: James Bond, the fictional spy

indicators.note: incomplete means the last letter is missing

parts.note: Edward is a royal prince
the Stuarts were a royal house, a dynasty

explanation.surface: Taxes owed to King James, with a half-crowned prince and an English Stuart among the royals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is a link word. The House of Stuart ruled England and Scotland in the 1600s.
explanation.definitionFit: Goods in a bonded warehouse are held until the import duty on them is paid.

clue.text: Immobilise white queen's starting position with black

parts.note: in chess notation the white queen starts on square d1, written D plus the numeral I
sable is the heraldic word for black

explanation.surface: A chess instruction to pin down the white queen on her home square with a black piece.
explanation.walkthrough: The numeral 1 is read as the letter I, so the chess square d1 gives DI.
explanation.definitionFit: To disable something is to put it out of action, to stop it working.

clue.text: Confuses though most basic, double confused

indicators.note: confused says the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: Something baffles even though it is utterly simple, twice as baffling.
explanation.definitionFit: To discombobulate someone is to bewilder or disconcert them.

clue.text: Cat and dog, perhaps, upset by bird and fish, showing wit

indicators.note: in a down clue upset means turned upside down, read bottom to top

parts.note: cats and dogs are examples of pets
a hen is a bird
fry are young fish

explanation.surface: Household animals troubled by poultry and young fish, proving clever.
explanation.walkthrough: 'showing' is a link word between wordplay and definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The writer, actor and quiz host is famous as a wit.

clue.text: Ruler of France taking the biscuit

definitions.meaning: a member of the royal house that held the French throne
a chocolate sandwich biscuit sold in Britain

explanation.surface: A French king grabbing the last biscuit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking the biscuit' is British for being the most outrageous; here 'taking the' just links. A bourbon is a chocolate-cream biscuit common in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: The Bourbon dynasty ruled France, and a British chocolate biscuit carries the same name.

clue.text: Frames with pole lifted after ten turns

indicators.note: after places the lifted pole behind the rearranged ten
turns says the letters of ten are rearranged
in a down clue lifted means read upwards, backwards

parts.note: a spar is a pole

explanation.surface: Something framed with a pole raised after ten spins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turns' rearranges TEN into ENT; 'lifted' turns SPAR into RAPS.
explanation.definitionFit: To frame someone is to set them up, to trap them, as entraps does.

clue.text: Cows drink in insects

parts.note: rum is a spirit, a drink
taken as written
ants are insects

explanation.surface: Cattle drinking among swarming insects.
explanation.definitionFit: Cows chew the cud and so belong to the cud-chewing animals.

clue.text: Time for virgin to return and break out

indicators.note: to return means the pieces are read backwards, last letter first

parts.note: virgin means pure, untouched

explanation.surface: A moment comes for an innocent to go home and escape.
explanation.definitionFit: To erupt is to burst out suddenly, as a volcano or a rash does.

clue.text: Catchy melody?

parts.note: a memorable musical phrase that grabs the listener, read also as a thing that literally catches, like a fisherman's barb

explanation.surface: A tune you cannot get out of your head.
explanation.definitionFit: In pop music the catchy phrase that snags the listener is called by the same word as a curved catching barb.

clue.text: Vote for Albion left out, hope mistakenly, though might this be the reason?

parts.note: a cross, X, is the mark made on a ballot paper

indicators.note: mistakenly says the letters are put together wrongly, in a new order
out tells us a letter is dropped from Albion

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Voting for England out of Europe in misplaced hope, perhaps driven by prejudice.
explanation.walkthrough: Albion is an old poetic name for Britain; the surface evokes the Brexit vote, and the definition hints at the prejudice behind it.
explanation.definitionFit: Fear and hatred of foreigners is suggested as the hidden motive behind such a vote.

clue.text: Appeared to be perfect model, then do I seem kinky embracing mine?

indicators.note: embracing says the rearranged letters hold the word for mine
kinky means twisted, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: a pit is a mine

explanation.surface: A model looked flawless, then wonders if she seems perverse in clinging to what's hers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Appeared to be perfect model' sounds like a fashion shoot, but it means served as the ideal example.
explanation.definitionFit: To epitomise is to be a perfect example of something.

clue.text: Fruit in hands …

parts.note: a paw is a hand, informally
a second paw, since hands is plural

explanation.surface: A fruit held in one's hands.
explanation.definitionFit: The pawpaw, or papaya, is a tropical fruit.

clue.text: … or in hands

parts.note: continuing the previous clue: a fruit that grows in clusters which growers call hands

explanation.surface: Following on, another fruit that comes in hands.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis borrows 'Fruit' from the clue before; a bunch of this fruit is called a hand.
explanation.definitionFit: Bunches of this yellow fruit are called hands, and each fruit a finger.

clue.text: Checker of car rust retired

parts.note: Audi is a make of car

indicators.note: retired means drawn back, so the word for rust is read in reverse

parts.note: rot, decay, stands for rust

explanation.surface: Someone who inspects a car for corrosion has stopped working.
explanation.definitionFit: An auditor checks a firm's accounts.

clue.text: Oaf seemingly unconcerned about northern Iraq, formerly

parts.note: an ass is a fool, an oaf

indicators.note: about means the word is turned round, read backwards

parts.note: airy means casual, apparently untroubled

explanation.surface: A fool appears unconcerned about the north of Iraq.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' looks like 'concerning' but turns AIRY into YRIA.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient empire of Assyria lay in what is now northern Iraq.

clue.text: Theatre worker part of the furniture?

definitions.meaning: a backstage person who helps actors into their costumes
a kitchen cabinet with shelves for crockery

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both an actor's backstage costume helper and a sideboard with shelves.

clue.text: Plant aggression caused by stink?

indicators.note: caused by places the word for aggression after the smell that causes it

parts.note: BO, body odour, is a stink
rage is violent anger, aggression

explanation.surface: Someone's smell provoking violent anger.
explanation.definitionFit: Borage is a blue-flowered herb.

clue.text: Adoring puzzle that's said not to be difficult to solve

definitions.text: that's said not to be difficult to solve

indicators.note: puzzle is taken as a verb, to confuse, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A loving puzzle that is supposed to be easy to crack.
explanation.walkthrough: The Gordian knot was famously intricate, yet Alexander the Great is said to have solved it simply by slicing through it with his sword.
explanation.definitionFit: Gordian describes a fiendishly tangled problem, after the legendary knot cut by Alexander.

clue.text: Hairstyle (women's) set in stone loosely as a deep thing

indicators.note: set in tells us the hairstyle and women's letter go inside the stone

parts.note: shale is a soft stone that splits loosely into thin layers
a perm is a hairstyle
W is the abbreviation for women

explanation.surface: A woman's permed hairdo carved loosely in stone, as a profound piece of art.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deep' here means the ocean depths, not profundity.
explanation.definitionFit: This whale dives deeper than any other, so it is a creature of the deep.

clue.text: Place for a backless back

indicators.note: backless means the word loses its last letter, its back

parts.note: the rear is the back

explanation.surface: A spot for a back without a back, like a strapless dress.
explanation.definitionFit: An area is a region or place.

clue.text: Despise decapitating something once beaten about hard

indicators.note: about means the shortened drum goes around the letter for hard
decapitating means the first letter is cut off

parts.note: a tabor is an old small drum, struck in medieval times
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: Hating the beheading of someone once thrashed brutally.
explanation.walkthrough: TABOR loses its head to give ABOR, which goes around H.
explanation.definitionFit: To abhor is to loathe or despise.

clue.text: Fruit from this on hand

definitions.meaning: a tree that bears dates or coconuts
the inner surface of the hand

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a tropical fruit tree and the inner surface of a hand.

clue.text: These associated with Eros especially

indicators.note: associated with indicates the letters are held within the words that follow

explanation.surface: Flowers linked above all with the god of love.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits across the join of 'Eros' and 'especially'; Eros is the Greek god of love, whose flower they are.
explanation.definitionFit: These red flowers are the classic emblem of love, the domain of the god Eros.

clue.text: Sort of frequency to bend almost half right round

parts.note: a U-bend is the U-shaped bend in a pipe, so bend gives U

indicators.note: round says the letters are turned about into a new order
almost means the last letter of half is dropped

explanation.surface: An instruction to bend something almost half a turn to the right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to bend' looks like an anagram signal, but 'to' is a link and 'bend' gives U, as in a plumber's U-bend.
explanation.definitionFit: Ultrahigh frequency (UHF) is a radio band used for television.

clue.text: Cut for a game of cards

parts.note: bridge is a card game

explanation.surface: Cutting the pack before a card game.
explanation.definitionFit: To abridge a text is to cut it, shortening it.

clue.text: Class remains disrupted

indicators.note: disrupted says the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A lesson continues to be disturbed.
explanation.definitionFit: A seminar is a small teaching class.
